label.zh: 若受创的巨龙摧毁我们的舰队
label.en: If the wounded Drake destroys our fleet

bridges.evidence: on_fleet_destroyed_perp (00_on_actions.txt:1641) -> hidden leviathans.648 (leviathans_events_1.txt:8266-8310): a red-dragon ship between 15% and 80% HP, no aggro_cooldown, in the guardians_dragon_system; it sends the retaliation order 652 and notifies the victim with 649

label.zh: 若我们的舰队在龙受创后紧急跃迁逃离
label.en: If our fleet flees by emergency FTL after wounding it

bridges.evidence: on_emergency_ftl (00_on_actions.txt:2893) -> leviathans.650 (leviathans_events_1.txt:8352-8422): default empire escaping the dragon system while a dragon at 15-80% HP is in combat; the dragon then pursues (hidden 651)

label.en: If we kill the Ether Drake

bridges.evidence: on_fleet_destroyed_perp (00_on_actions.txt:1643) -> leviathans.670 (leviathans_events_1.txt:9004-9142): victim is a guardian_dragon country that is not the rubricator or here-be-the-dragon dragon

label.zh: 以太巨龙被亡灵法师复活

note.zh: 创建一支被动的复活大龙舰队“Avice”。
note.en: Creates a passive reanimated grand dragon fleet.

note.zh: 三选一（按能力）：获得300影响力与龙战利品遗物；亡灵师可启动复活项目；可收割DNA者获得DNA标记。指挥官得到“屠龙者”特质，并开启庆典情境。
note.en: Three options by capability: 300 influence and the dragon trophy relic; a reanimator may start the reanimation project; a DNA harvester gets the harvested flag. The commander gains the Dragonslayer trait and a celebration situation starts.

notes.zh: 审阅注：玩家（或堕落帝国）的舰队进入标有 guardians_dragon_system、且有红龙舰船的星系时触发，每帝国一次（dragon_encounter；on_entering_system_fleet，00_on_actions.txt:998）。巨龙受伤会追击撤退的舰队并报复其有空间站的星系（隐藏 648/651/652/654），血量低于16%时撤回休眠修复（隐藏 655）。这些追击细节只作说明，未建模。
notes.en: Review note: fires once per empire (dragon_encounter) when a default or fallen empire fleet enters a guardians_dragon_system with a red-dragon ship (on_entering_system_fleet, 00_on_actions.txt:998). A wounded Drake pursues fleeing fleets and raids systems where the victim has stations (hidden 648/651/652/654) and below 16% HP retreats to hibernate and repair (hidden 655). These pursuit details are described, not modelled.

notes.zh: 审阅注：“龙的宝库”小行星现在可以安全开采，详见“龙之宝藏”故事。
notes.en: Review note: the Dragon's Hoard planetoid it guarded is covered by its own story (Dragon's Hoard).

scope.zh: 完整：遭遇、报复通知、击杀与复活项目。隐藏追击逻辑仅作说明。
scope.en: Complete: encounter, retaliation notices, kill and reanimation. Hidden pursuit logic described only.

uncertain: The pursuit/hibernation behaviour of hidden events 640-655 was read only at summary level.
